title: deploymentConfig
responsibility: Resolves a project-relative configuration path and refuses paths outside the repository.

inputs.name: deploymentPath.root
inputs.description: Project directory used to resolve the path; the result must be a nonempty descendant of this root.

inputs.name: deploymentPath.path
inputs.description: Path resolved against root; a resolved path equal to the root or outside it throws.

inputs.name: deploymentConfig.root
inputs.description: Project root from which deployment settings and Wrangler files are read; its Git branch is used only when harness.deploy.json does not provide sourceBranch.

outputs.name: deploymentPath
outputs.description: Resolved absolute filesystem path inside the project; paths resolving to the root itself or outside it throw.

outputs.name: deploymentConfig
outputs.description: Configuration result with sourceBranch, configured or detected targets, and a SHA-256 fingerprint of deployment-settings text followed by Wrangler-file text. Target candidates that fail schema parsing are omitted, and the call rejects when configuration or safety checks fail.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown or propagated when settings or Wrangler data cannot be read or parsed, project paths fail containment, explicit target or safety checks fail, or Worker account/name pairs are not distinct.
